scope: Final RR-window-convolved DESI DR1 LRGxELG 120-mock finite-ensemble calibration

comparison_to_prewindow.interpretation: The survey-window-convolved forward model leaves both finite-mock empirical tail counts unchanged.

interpretation: The RR-window-convolved matched filter gives nominal Z=2.210. Finite-mock calibration yields two-sided equivalents of 1.84 sigma and 1.96 sigma for the absolute matched-filter and Sellentin–Heavens statistics. We interpret the result as a tentative consistency indication, not a detection.
analysis_scope: The reported inference uses the specified bins, pair orientation, random density, survey-window model and theoretical templates.
